categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for patients after successful treatment and ward admission, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release A (id=17) under the discharge goal decomposition (id=6). Supported by frequent variants like V0008, V0070, and V0069.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway following ward treatment, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release B (id=18) under the discharge goal decomposition (id=6). Supported by rare/alternative variants such as V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents a specific discharge route for long-stay or complex admitted patients, measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release C (id=19) under the discharge goal decomposition (id=6), observed in long complex cases such as V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents a distinct discharge pathway for admitted cases, measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release D (id=20) under the discharge goal decomposition (id=6), evidenced in sample variant V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway under the mutually exclusive discharge goal decomposition.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release E (id=21) under the discharge goal decomposition (id=6). Maintained as a distinct category per the XOR constraint even without high representation in the current sample.
